title: Christmas Carols at Hotel du Vin Tunbridge Wells
description: Celebrate the magic of Christmas at Hotel du Vin Tunbridge Wells on 24th December with an evening of carols. Starting at 7:30 PM in our hotel lobby, enjoy a performance by the Royal Tunbridge Wells Choral Society (RTWCS). After the carols, why not continue the celebrations with a dinner in our bistro? Contact us to reserve your table.
address: Hotel du Vin Tunbridge Wells, Crescent Road, Royal Tunbridge Wells, TN1 2LY
